content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three allowed absorber materials, their radiation/interaction lengths or densities if provided, and assign each material a numeric ID for later recording."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read the simulation-related project documents to determine how 100 GeV electron energy resolution depends on absorber material and plate thickness in the allowed 2–10 mm range. For each candidate material, identify the plate thickness that gives the lowest simulated energy resolution, and record the material ID, thickness in mm, and energy resolution in percent."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the activation/radiation-safety project documents to determine the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown for each candidate material and relevant plate thickness. Record the residual dose rate in uSv/h for the best-resolution configuration of each material, and if needed for nearby alternative thicknesses."},{"id":"s4","description":"Apply the hard cuts: energy resolution at 100 GeV must be <=4.5%, residual dose rate must be <=20 uSv/h, and thickness must be between 2 and 10 mm. Record numeric pass/fail flags for each candidate configuration."},{"id":"s5","description":"Among configurations passing all hard requirements, select the one with the smallest 100 GeV energy resolution. Record the chosen material ID, plate thickness in mm, expected energy resolution in percent, and expected residual dose rate in uSv/h for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F3","plate_mm":2,"justification":"No configuration was found that passes all hard requirements because the executed steps found no 100 GeV energy-resolution simulation data and no validated best thickness for any candidate. Absorber-F2 and Absorber-F3 meet the dose requirement, with Absorber-F3 having the lower residual dose (6 uSv/h versus 12 uSv/h).
